description_en: Invokes GetLiveRoomUserStatistics to query user viewing statistics for a specified live room by paging. This operation is planned to be migrated to a new solution and is not recommended
description_zh: 调用GetLiveRoomUserStatistics分页查询与指定直播相关的用户观看数据。后续计划迁入新方案，不推荐使用
name: GetLiveRoomUserStatistics

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when the application is created in the console. The ID consists of lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live resource
parameters.name: live_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to query, starting from 1. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从1开始，参数为空默认查询第1页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示个数，最大支持50，参数为空默认显示个数为10
parameters.name: page_size
